Signature.Documentation: This test case tests a CB-AdES-B-B signature built on an untagged COSE_Sign1 structure with attached payload. Apart from the protected header parameters alg, CWT Claims (enclosing iat) and x5chain, the implementation shall add the protected sigPId header parameter (label 266), built as in the sigPId test case, and the sigPSt unsigned component (label 7) as the only element of the uHeaders unprotected header parameter (clause 5.3.2). The sigPSt shall contain the docOrLocalUri member (key 1) with the sigPolDoc choice (key 1) encapsulating the signature policy document itself. sigPId is present because sigPSt may only be incorporated if sigPId is present and contains the digest of the policy document (Table 14, requirement b). The signature policy document, its identifier (to be encoded as an oId whose id member is a URI, or an URN if it is an OID) and the URL where it is published will be provided by the Plugtests portal. No other optional component shall be present. The x5chain header parameter shall be a protected header parameter. At least the signing certificate shall be included in x5chain; the certificates needed for building the certification path should also be included.
